generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force classes, CRESTA/state zones, construction types and customer segments carrying claim or exposure volume.
generic.In-scope period: The last 12 rolling quarters of claims and exposure with the equivalent prior-year quarters as comparatives.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim count, incurred amount, exposure units, class code, zone, construction type and segment present on every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim counts and incurred totals in the trend workbook agree to the claims data mart extract for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trend workbook header carries the data-as-at date, the paid or incurred basis and the extract version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every segment beyond the movement tolerance carries a written driver comment splitting large-loss from attritional.
generic.Test population: Every class, zone, construction type and segment combination present in the 12 rolling quarter dataset.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Frequency or severity movement beyond the agreed tolerance versus prior year must carry a driver comment.
generic.Exception handling path: Segments below credibility volume are footnoted and referred to the Portfolio UW Manager rather than trended.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Trends produced by class, geography, construction and segment with prior-year comparatives and driver commentary.
generic.Evidence location: Trend workbook and its refreshed Power BI page stored in the portfolio reporting library for the quarter.

steps.title: Extract claim counts and incurred amounts from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Query the claims mart for claim counts and incurred amounts across the last 12 rolling quarters.
Return class code, CRESTA or state, construction type and customer segment on each row.
Pull the matching prior-year quarters in the same query so comparatives share the extract.
Done when the 12-quarter claims extract with prior-year comparatives is loaded.
verify: Check the quarter count returned equals 12 plus the comparative quarters.
Pass when every extracted row carries class, zone, construction type and segment.

steps.title: Join exposure units to the claims extract in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Join in-force exposure units for each segment and quarter to the claims extract.
Use the same segment and zone coding on both sides so the join does not drop rows.
List any claim row with no matching exposure record for research.
Done when every claims row carries an exposure denominator or an unmatched flag.
verify: Compare joined row count to the source claims row count.
Pass when no claim row is silently dropped by the exposure join.

steps.title: Compute frequency per 100 exposure units in Microsoft Excel
sop: Calculate claim frequency per 100 exposure units for each segment and quarter.
Place the prior-year figure side by side with the current figure for each segment.
Suppress the frequency where exposure falls below the credibility threshold.
Done when frequency and its prior-year comparative are computed for every segment.
verify: Recompute frequency for a sample of five segments by hand.
Pass when recomputed frequency matches the workbook for every sampled segment.

steps.title: Split severity into large-loss and attritional components in Microsoft Excel
sop: Calculate average severity per segment and quarter from incurred amount over claim count.
Separate claims above the large-loss threshold from attritional claims and compute each severity separately.
Show total, large-loss and attritional severity so a single loss cannot drive the trend unseen.
Done when severity is split into large-loss and attritional for every segment.
verify: Check large-loss plus attritional incurred sums back to total incurred per segment.
Pass when the two components reconcile to total incurred for every segment.

steps.title: Flag segments beyond tolerance and add driver comments in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compare current frequency and severity to prior year for each segment against the agreed tolerance.
Flag every segment outside tolerance in either measure.
Write a driver comment on each flag naming mix, rate, large loss or claims experience.
Done when every flagged segment carries a written driver comment.
verify: Count flagged segments against those carrying a comment.
Pass when no flagged segment is left without a driver comment.

steps.title: Publish the trend view to Power BI with data-as-at header
sop: Refresh the frequency and severity trend pages in Power BI from the completed dataset.
Stamp the data-as-at date and the paid or incurred basis on the report header.
Confirm the drill-down from class to zone and construction type resolves after refresh.
Done when the refreshed trend view is published with its header stamps.
verify: Open the published page and read the header stamps.
Pass when data-as-at date and paid or incurred basis are visible on the published page.

steps.title: Review the trend pack with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the flagged segments and the driver commentary against the underwriting view of the book.
Challenge any movement attributed to a single large loss without supporting detail.
Record acceptance or the rework required against each contested flag.
Done when the trend analysis is accepted or returned with specific rework.
verify: Check every contested flag carries a recorded outcome.
Pass when the manager records acceptance and no contested flag is left open.

generic.Defined scope/population: The signed-off quarterly portfolio pack plus the source data extract used to build it for each line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The closed reporting quarter, archived after leadership sign-off and before the next quarter opens.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: File name, data-as-at date, retention class, disposal date and quarter index populated on the archived record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived pack figures match the signed-off version circulated to underwriting leadership for that quarter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pack stored as an immutable PDF named to convention with the data-as-at date in the file properties.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any pack archived late or without its source extract is logged with the reason and the remediation date.
generic.Test population: All quarterly portfolio packs archived in the period across every line of business.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Archive fails if any draft version remains or if retention class and disposal date are unset.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or unretrievable prior-quarter packs are escalated to the Portfolio UW Manager before the archive step closes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Immutable pack and source extract archived to convention, indexed and retrievable by quarter, line and treaty year.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting records archive with the retention class applied and the index entry for the quarter.

steps.title: Confirm the pack is the signed-off final version in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compare the pack to be archived against the version signed off by underwriting leadership.
Confirm no figures or commentary changed after sign-off.
Reject any working copy carrying tracked changes or unresolved comments.
Done when the final signed-off version is identified for archiving.
verify: Check the sign-off record date against the file modified date.
Pass when the file predates or matches the sign-off with no later edits.

steps.title: Export the pack to an immutable PDF from Microsoft Excel
sop: Export the final pack to PDF with no editable layers or embedded working sheets.
Confirm every page renders including charts sourced from Power BI.
Set the document to read-only before it leaves the working area.
Done when the immutable PDF is produced and renders in full.
verify: Open the PDF and page through the full document.
Pass when every section renders and the file cannot be edited.

steps.title: Capture the source data extract from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Save the exact source extract used to build the pack alongside the PDF.
Record the query or dataset identifier and the extract timestamp with it.
Confirm the extract reproduces the headline figures in the pack.
Done when the source extract is stored with the pack.
verify: Recompute one headline figure from the stored extract.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the pack.

steps.title: Apply the naming convention and data-as-at properties
sop: Rename the file to LOB_PortfolioReview_QTR_YYYY_vFinal exactly as the convention states.
Write the data-as-at date into the file properties rather than the file name only.
Check the line of business and quarter tokens against the pack contents.
Done when the file name and properties match the convention.
verify: Read the file name and properties back after saving.
Pass when name tokens and the data-as-at property are both correct.

steps.title: Set retention class and disposal date on the archive record
sop: Apply the underwriting management reporting retention class to the archived record.
Set the disposal date derived from the retention period and the archive date.
Confirm the record is locked against deletion before the disposal date.
Done when retention class and disposal date are set on the record.
verify: Inspect the record metadata after saving.
Pass when both retention class and disposal date are populated.

steps.title: Index the pack for quarter, line and treaty-year retrieval
sop: Add index entries for reporting quarter, line of business and reinsurance treaty year.
Confirm a search on each index dimension returns the archived pack.
Remove any draft or working version left in the archive location.
Done when the pack is indexed and no drafts remain.
verify: Search the archive by quarter and by treaty year.
Pass when both searches return the final pack and no draft version.

steps.title: Confirm prior-quarter retrievability with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Retrieve the prior quarter pack from the archive as a live retrievability check.
Confirm the retrieved pack opens with its source extract still attached.
Sign the archive step as complete for the quarter.
Done when prior-quarter retrievability is confirmed and the step is signed.
verify: Check the retrieval test result is recorded against the quarter.
Pass when the manager records a successful prior-quarter retrieval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every line of business with an approved plan, benchmarked against plan, prior year and the relevant market loss index.
generic.In-scope period: The closed reporting quarter with year-to-date and prior-year equivalents on the same basis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, plan figure, prior-year figure and index value present per line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actual premium and loss totals in the benchmark view agree to the ledger close for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark output records the plan version of record, the index source and the index vintage used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every line beyond the agreed variance tolerance carries commentary naming rate, mix or loss experience.
generic.Test population: All lines of business appearing in the approved plan of record for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Variance beyond the agreed tolerance without commentary fails the benchmark review.
generic.Exception handling path: Lines with no comparable market index are footnoted and benchmarked against plan and prior year only.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Actual versus plan versus prior year versus market index by line with variance in points and dollars.
generic.Evidence location: Benchmark workbook and the published Power BI benchmark page for the quarter.

steps.title: Load actuals by line of business from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract actual written premium, loss ratio and combined ratio by line for the closed period.
Use the same earned or written basis across every line so comparison is valid.
Record the extract timestamp with the dataset.
Done when actuals are loaded for every line in scope.
verify: Compare the line list in the extract to the plan line list.
Pass when every planned line has actuals loaded.

steps.title: Attach the plan of record and prior-year figures in Power BI
sop: Load the approved plan figures and confirm the plan version matches the plan of record.
Attach prior-year actuals on the same basis as the current period.
Reject any plan file that is not the approved version.
Done when plan and prior-year figures are attached to every line.
verify: Read the plan version reference on the dataset.
Pass when the plan version equals the plan of record.

steps.title: Overlay the market loss index in the Actuarial modeling platform
sop: Obtain the relevant market loss index or peer benchmark for the same period per line.
Record the index source and vintage against each line.
Footnote lines where no comparable index exists.
Done when an index value or a footnote sits against every line.
verify: Check the source and vintage fields on each index value.
Pass when no index value is used without a recorded source and vintage.

steps.title: Calculate variance in points and dollars in Power BI
sop: Calculate variance to plan in percentage points and in dollars for each line.
Rank segments by absolute dollar variance so the largest movers surface first.
Show variance to prior year alongside variance to plan.
Done when both variance measures are calculated and ranked.
verify: Recompute dollar variance for the top three ranked lines.
Pass when recomputed variance matches the published figures.

steps.title: Write driver commentary for out-of-tolerance lines in Power BI
sop: Identify every line more than the agreed tolerance off plan.
Write commentary naming rate, mix or loss experience as the driver for each.
Avoid generic commentary that does not identify a specific driver.
Done when every out-of-tolerance line carries named-driver commentary.
verify: Count out-of-tolerance lines against commented lines.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Reconcile benchmark totals to the ledger close
sop: Compare total actual premium and incurred loss in the benchmark to the ledger close figures.
Record any difference and its cause on the benchmark output.
Correct the extract where the difference is a mapping or timing error.
Done when the reconciliation is recorded with any residual explained.
verify: Read the recorded reconciliation difference.
Pass when the residual difference is within tolerance and explained.

steps.title: Review and release the benchmark with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the ranked variances and the driver commentary for underwriting plausibility.
Challenge commentary that does not match the known rate or mix position.
Approve release of the benchmark view to underwriting leadership.
Done when the benchmark is approved for release.
verify: Check the approval is recorded against the quarter.
Pass when the manager approval is recorded before publication.

generic.Defined scope/population: The whole portfolio plus every segment and every underwriter with in-force premium in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The closed accounting period with ratios stated on a declared earned or written basis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Earned premium, written premium, incurred loss, ALAE, ULAE, acquisition cost and operating cost present per level.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Earned premium and incurred loss in the calculation tie to the general-ledger close for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Output states the earned or written basis, whether ratios are ALAE-inclusive, and the extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments below the minimum credibility threshold are suppressed or footnoted rather than published as ratios.
generic.Test population: Portfolio, segment and underwriter levels for the closed accounting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Any ledger reconciliation difference above tolerance must be explained before ratios are published.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled differences are referred to the Portfolio UW Manager and finance before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loss, expense and combined ratios at portfolio, segment and underwriter level on a stated basis with reconciliation.
generic.Evidence location: Ratio calculation workbook and the published Power BI ratio pages for the period.

steps.title: Extract premium and loss by level from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract earned and written premium and incurred losses at portfolio, segment and underwriter level.
Pull gross and net of reinsurance amounts so both bases can be reported.
Record the extract timestamp and source tables.
Done when premium and loss are extracted at all three levels.
verify: Sum segment figures back to the portfolio total.
Pass when segment sums equal the portfolio total.

steps.title: Apply the ALAE and ULAE convention in the Actuarial modeling platform
sop: Add ALAE and ULAE to incurred losses per the agreed convention.
State on the output whether the ratios are ALAE-inclusive.
Keep the ALAE-exclusive figure available so the effect of the convention is visible.
Done when the loss base is stated with the ALAE and ULAE treatment applied.
verify: Read the basis statement on the output.
Pass when the output declares the ALAE and ULAE treatment used.

steps.title: Compute gross and net loss ratios in the Actuarial modeling platform
sop: Compute gross and net loss ratio on both earned and written bases at each level.
Apply the same denominator basis consistently across the portfolio and its segments.
Label each ratio with its basis so the figures cannot be mixed downstream.
Done when loss ratios are computed and labelled at all three levels.
verify: Recompute loss ratio for three underwriters by hand.
Pass when the recomputed ratios match the calculation output.

steps.title: Derive expense and combined ratios in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute the expense ratio from acquisition and operating costs on the agreed allocation.
Add the loss and expense ratios to derive the combined ratio at each level.
Confirm allocated costs sum to total costs before deriving the combined ratio.
Done when expense and combined ratios exist at all three levels.
verify: Sum allocated costs and compare to total operating and acquisition cost.
Pass when allocated costs equal total costs.

steps.title: Reconcile earned premium and incurred loss to the ledger close
sop: Compare total earned premium and incurred losses to the general-ledger close figures.
Record any difference and trace it to timing, mapping or accrual causes.
Correct the extract where the cause is a mapping error.
Done when the reconciliation is recorded with any difference explained.
verify: Read the recorded reconciliation and residual difference.
Pass when the residual is within tolerance and its cause is stated.

steps.title: Suppress low-credibility segments before publishing in Power BI
sop: Identify segments with exposures below the minimum credibility threshold.
Suppress or footnote those ratios rather than publishing a volatile figure.
Keep the underlying numbers available on request for the suppressed segments.
Done when low-credibility segments are suppressed or footnoted.
verify: Scan the published pages for unsuppressed low-volume segments.
Pass when no sub-threshold segment shows an unfootnoted ratio.

steps.title: Approve the ratio set with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the ratios and the ledger reconciliation before release.
Challenge underwriter-level ratios that conflict with known book movements.
Approve the ratio set for use in portfolio reporting.
Done when the ratio set is approved for release.
verify: Check the approval record for the period.
Pass when the manager approval is recorded before publication.

generic.Defined scope/population: The top emerging portfolio risks and trends identified for the period across all monitored segments.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting month, issued ahead of the monthly underwriting meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Segment, observed movement, recommended action, tag, owner and target date present on every brief item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items in the brief match the flagged items on the portfolio watchlist for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated brief and any CUO direction logged against the portfolio review record for the period.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items downgraded from escalate to monitor are logged with the reason and the deciding role.
generic.Test population: All emerging-risk items communicated to the CUO and product management in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Any act-now item without a named owner and target date fails the brief review.
generic.Exception handling path: Items the CUO defers are carried to the next monthly brief with the deferral reason recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: One-page dated brief with each item tagged monitor, act now or escalate and an owner named.
generic.Evidence location: Portfolio review record for the month holding the brief and the logged CUO direction.

steps.title: Shortlist emerging risks from the Power BI portfolio views
sop: Review the trend, concentration and appetite pages for movements needing leadership attention.
Shortlist the risks that warrant action rather than routine monitoring.
Record the segment and the observed movement behind each shortlisted item.
Done when the shortlist of emerging risks is drafted.
verify: Cross-check the shortlist against the portfolio watchlist.
Pass when every watchlist item beyond tolerance appears or is explicitly excluded.

steps.title: Draft the one-page brief in Microsoft Excel
sop: Write each item as segment, observed movement and recommended action on one page.
Keep the brief to a single page so it is usable at the underwriting meeting.
State the premium or exposure at stake for each item.
Done when the one-page brief is drafted with all items.
verify: Check every item states segment, movement and recommended action.
Pass when no item is missing one of the three elements.

steps.title: Tag each item monitor, act now or escalate
sop: Apply the monitor, act now or escalate tag to every item using the agreed criteria.
Name the owner and target date for each act-now item.
Escalate items that exceed the manager authority level to the CUO explicitly.
Done when every item carries a tag and act-now items carry owner and date.
verify: Filter for act-now items without an owner or date.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Validate the figures behind the brief with the Portfolio Analyst
sop: Re-check the movement figures quoted in the brief against the source portfolio views.
Correct any figure that does not tie to the published view.
Confirm the data-as-at date quoted matches the source.
Done when every figure in the brief ties to a published view.
verify: Trace three quoted figures back to the source page.
Pass when all three trace exactly.

steps.title: Issue the brief to the CUO and product management
sop: Send the brief to the Chief Underwriting Officer and product management before the monthly meeting.
Confirm the distribution reaches all required recipients.
State the meeting at which the items will be discussed.
Done when the brief is issued ahead of the monthly underwriting meeting.
verify: Check the send date against the meeting date.
Pass when the brief was issued before the meeting.

steps.title: Capture CUO direction on each item
sop: Review the tagged items and confirm, upgrade or downgrade each tag.
Give direction on the act-now items including any change of owner or date.
State which items require an appetite or guideline change rather than monitoring.
Done when direction is given on every item in the brief.
verify: Check every brief item carries a recorded CUO response.
Pass when no item is left without direction.

steps.title: Log the communication and direction on the portfolio review record
sop: Log the brief, its send date and the recipient list against the portfolio review record.
Record the CUO direction item by item so the trail survives to the next quarter.
Carry unresolved items into the next monthly brief.
Done when the brief and direction are logged on the review record.
verify: Retrieve the review record and read the logged direction.
Pass when the brief, recipients and direction are all present on the record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force and written policies by line of business and segment with their matching claims cohort.
generic.In-scope period: The closed reporting period with the data-as-at timestamp stamped on the extract.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written, earned and in-force premium, policy count, paid, outstanding and incurred loss, segment, class and geography codes.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total written premium in the extract reconciles to the bordereau or ledger control total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract stamped with the data-as-at timestamp and the source system versions used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records with null or unmapped segment, class or geography codes are routed to the data-quality log.
generic.Test population: Every policy and claim record in the closed period extract by line of business and segment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Extract fails if any published record carries a null or unmapped segment, class or geography code.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped records go to the data-quality log and are excluded from publication until corrected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premium and loss extract by segment and LOB with data-as-at timestamp and a control-total reconciliation.
generic.Evidence location: Portfolio metrics dataset in the enterprise data warehouse and its Power BI reporting layer.

steps.title: Extract premium and policy counts from the policy administration system
sop: Extract written, earned and in-force premium and policy counts by line of business and segment.
Apply the closed-period boundary so mid-period endorsements land in the right period.
Record the source system version with the extract.
Done when premium and count data are extracted for the closed period.
verify: Compare policy counts to the in-force count report for the same date.
Pass when the counts agree within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Join claims data from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Join paid, outstanding and incurred losses for the same cohort and period from the claims data mart.
Match on policy and cover identifiers rather than name or free text.
List claims that fail to match a policy for research.
Done when losses are joined to the premium cohort.
verify: Count unmatched claims after the join.
Pass when every unmatched claim appears on the research list.

steps.title: Reconcile written premium to the control total
sop: Compare total written premium in the extract to the bordereau or ledger control total.
Record the variance and trace it to timing, cancellation or mapping causes.
Correct the extract where the cause is a mapping error.
Done when the reconciliation and any variance are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded variance against the control total.
Pass when the variance is within tolerance and its cause is stated.

steps.title: Check for null or unmapped codes in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Scan the extract for null or unmapped segment, class and geography codes.
Route every unmapped record to the data-quality log with the failing field named.
Hold unmapped records out of the published extract until corrected.
Done when all unmapped records are logged and excluded.
verify: Query the published extract for null or unmapped codes.
Pass when the query returns no rows.

steps.title: Stamp the extract with data-as-at and source versions
sop: Write the data-as-at timestamp onto the extract header.
Record the policy administration and claims mart source versions used.
Version the extract so a rerun does not overwrite the published one.
Done when the extract carries its timestamp and source versions.
verify: Read the extract header after publication.
Pass when timestamp and source versions are both present.

steps.title: Publish the metrics dataset to Power BI
sop: Publish the reconciled extract to the Power BI portfolio dataset.
Confirm the refresh completes and the headline tiles match the extract totals.
Check drill-down from line of business to segment resolves.
Done when the dataset is published and tiles reconcile.
verify: Compare two headline tiles to the extract totals.
Pass when both tiles match the extract.

steps.title: Review and accept the extract with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the reconciliation, the data-quality log and the published totals.
Challenge any material movement not explained by known book activity.
Accept the extract for downstream portfolio reporting.
Done when the extract is accepted for downstream use.
verify: Check the acceptance record for the period.
Pass when acceptance is recorded before downstream reporting starts.

generic.Defined scope/population: The standard quarterly pack sections for every line of business reported to underwriting leadership.
generic.In-scope period: The closed quarter, with the draft circulated at least five working days before the review meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Overview, premium and mix movement, loss ratio walk, top segments, CAT summary and action log all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Summary page headline loss ratio and premium agree to the detail pages and the ledger close.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dashboard refresh timestamp shown on the report page and matched to the closed-quarter dataset.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sections that cannot be completed on time are logged with the reason and the date they will follow.
generic.Test population: All standard sections of the quarterly pack plus the carried-forward action log items.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pack fails review if any standard section is missing or the action log is not carried forward.
generic.Exception handling path: Late or missing source data is flagged on the affected page and escalated to the Portfolio UW Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete quarterly pack with all standard sections, current action status and a matching refresh timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: Quarterly portfolio pack file and the refreshed Power BI leadership dashboard for the quarter.

steps.title: Assemble the standard pack sections in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build the pack with portfolio overview, premium and mix movement, loss ratio walk and top segments.
Add the CAT exposure summary and the actions log as standard sections.
Use the approved template so section order matches the prior quarter.
Done when every standard section is present in the draft pack.
verify: Check the section list against the approved template.
Pass when no standard section is missing.

steps.title: Refresh the leadership dashboard in Power BI
sop: Refresh the leadership dashboard against the closed-quarter dataset.
Confirm the refresh timestamp appears on the report page.
Confirm the dataset used is the closed-quarter version and not an open period.
Done when the dashboard is refreshed and stamped.
verify: Read the refresh timestamp on the report page.
Pass when the timestamp matches the closed-quarter dataset.

steps.title: Carry forward the prior quarter action log
sop: Copy the prior quarter action log into the current pack.
Update the status of each open item with its current position and owner.
Close items evidenced as complete and state the closure evidence.
Done when every prior action carries a current status.
verify: Filter for actions without a current status.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Cross-check headline figures against detail and ledger
sop: Compare the summary page headline loss ratio and premium to the detail pages.
Compare the same figures to the ledger close for the quarter.
Correct or footnote any difference before circulation.
Done when the headline figures tie to detail and ledger.
verify: Recheck two headline figures against detail and ledger.
Pass when both tie or carry an explained footnote.

steps.title: Add commentary from the enterprise data warehouse analysis
sop: Write commentary on premium and mix movement and the loss ratio walk drivers.
Ground every comment in a figure available in the pack or its source dataset.
Remove commentary that cannot be evidenced from the data.
Done when each analytical section carries evidenced commentary.
verify: Trace two commentary claims to their source figures.
Pass when both claims trace to a figure in the pack.

steps.title: Circulate the draft pack for leadership review
sop: Circulate the draft pack to underwriting leadership at least five working days before the meeting.
State the review deadline and where comments should be sent.
Log the circulation date and recipient list.
Done when the draft is circulated within the required lead time.
verify: Compare the circulation date to the meeting date.
Pass when at least five working days separate them.

steps.title: Incorporate review comments and finalise with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the draft pack and the action log status with the analyst.
Record the disposition of every review comment received.
Approve the final pack for the leadership review meeting.
Done when the pack is finalised and approved.
verify: Check every review comment carries a disposition.
Pass when no comment is left undispositioned at approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriting team receiving a segment scorecard for the reporting quarter.
generic.In-scope period: The closed quarter, distributed after the portfolio pack is signed off by leadership.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss ratio, hit ratio and retention against target populated on every team scorecard.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of team scorecard premium and losses reconciles to the portfolio totals for the quarter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Send date and recipient list recorded on the portfolio review record for the quarter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Distribution failures or access issues are logged and resolved before the quarter closes.
generic.Test population: All team scorecards distributed and all recipients on the distribution list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Distribution fails if underwriter-level results are visible outside the owning manager.
generic.Exception handling path: Access issues route to the Portfolio Analyst for permission correction and are re-tested before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Team scorecards issued with loss ratio, hit ratio and retention against target and a dated recipient list.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI scorecard workspace and the portfolio review record holding the distribution log.

steps.title: Build team segment scorecards in Power BI
sop: Build a scorecard per underwriting team showing loss ratio, hit ratio and retention against target.
Use the signed-off quarterly figures so scorecards match the leadership pack.
Include the prior-quarter comparative on each measure.
Done when a scorecard exists for every underwriting team.
verify: Compare the scorecard list to the underwriting team list.
Pass when every team has a scorecard.

steps.title: Apply row-level security to underwriter results in Power BI
sop: Restrict underwriter-level rows so each manager sees only their own team.
Test the restriction with a manager account from another team.
Correct any leakage before distribution.
Done when row-level security is applied and tested.
verify: Open a scorecard as an out-of-team manager account.
Pass when no other team underwriter rows are visible.

steps.title: Draft the what-this-means-for-you note in Microsoft Excel
sop: Write a short note per team naming the two or three actions expected this quarter.
Tie each action to a specific measure on that team scorecard.
Keep the note to a length a team will actually read.
