generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Peaks where no viable lever exists are logged with the reason and escalated to the CUO.
generic.Test population: All peak zones identified in the current accumulation cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each peak must carry a preferred option and target implementation date to pass review.
generic.Exception handling path: Recommendations rejected by the decision forum return with the alternative lever to be modelled.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pack listing peak-driving policies with candidate levers, modelled relief and premium impact per option.
generic.Evidence location: Recommendation pack and the Power BI peak contribution page for the cycle.

steps.title: Rank peak-driving policies in Power BI
sop: Identify the locations and policies driving each concentration peak.
Rank them by contribution to zonal PML rather than by TIV alone.
Record the accumulation run identifier behind the ranking.
Done when driving policies are ranked for every peak zone.
verify: Reconcile ranked contributions to the zonal PML in the run.
Pass when ranked contributions sum consistently with the run output.

steps.title: Set out candidate levers per peak
sop: List the candidate levers for each peak from the agreed set.
Include non-renewal, limit or line-size reduction, higher deductible, facultative cession and new-business suspension.
Exclude levers barred by contract or regulation and state why.
Done when candidate levers are listed for every peak zone.
verify: Check each peak carries at least two candidate levers or a stated reason.
Pass when no peak is left without options or an explanation.

steps.title: Quantify modelled relief and premium given up
sop: Model the exposure relief delivered by each lever for each peak zone.
Quantify the premium given up under each option.
Present the relief and premium trade-off side by side.
Done when relief and premium impact are quantified for every option.
verify: Check every listed option shows both relief and premium impact.
Pass when no option is missing either figure.

steps.title: Check lever feasibility in the underwriting workstation
sop: Check that each proposed lever can be enforced through workstation rules or renewal actions.
Confirm the notice periods and renewal dates allow the target implementation date.
Discard levers that cannot be enforced in the required window.
Done when only enforceable levers remain in the pack.
verify: Test one proposed lever as a rule in the workstation.
Pass when the tested lever can be configured as described.

steps.title: Recommend a preferred option per peak zone
sop: Recommend one preferred option for each peak zone with the reasoning stated.
Set the target implementation date for each preferred option.
Note the residual peak position after the recommended action.
Done when every peak zone carries a preferred option and target date.
verify: Filter peak zones for missing preferred option or date.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Route the pack for decision and record the outcome
sop: Route the recommendation pack to the Portfolio UW Manager and CUO for decision.
Record the decision against each peak zone with any conditions.
Return rejected recommendations with the alternative lever to be modelled.
Done when a decision is recorded against every peak zone.
verify: Check every peak zone in the pack carries a recorded decision.
Pass when no peak zone is left undecided.

generic.Defined scope/population: All key perils with modelled PML plus every open zonal breach and approved exception.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter, tabled at the scheduled risk management committee.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: PML at agreed return periods gross and net, appetite threshold, reinsurance cover and breach status populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: PML figures in the report tie to the accumulation run identifier cited in the appendix.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report cites the accumulation run identifier, model version and reinsurance structure version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open breaches and approved exceptions are listed with status and expiry date.
generic.Test population: All key perils and all open zonal breaches for the reporting quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report fails if PML figures cannot be tied to the cited accumulation run.
generic.Exception handling path: Committee-requested rework is logged with the owner and the date it will be retabled.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quarterly CAT report showing gross and net PML against appetite and reinsurance cover with minuted tabling.
generic.Evidence location: Committee pack for the quarter and the risk management committee minutes.

steps.title: Assemble PML at agreed return periods in Power BI
sop: Assemble modelled PML at the agreed return periods for each key peril.
Show the figures gross and net of reinsurance.
Cite the accumulation run identifier behind the figures.
Done when PML is assembled gross and net for every key peril.
verify: Trace two PML figures back to the cited run.
Pass when both figures match the run output.

steps.title: Compare aggregate exposure to board risk appetite
sop: Compare aggregate CAT exposure to the board risk appetite thresholds.
Show the vertical and horizontal reinsurance cover against the modelled position.
State the headroom or shortfall against each threshold.
Done when the appetite comparison is prepared for every key peril.
verify: Check the appetite thresholds cited are the current board-approved values.
Pass when the thresholds match the approved appetite statement.

steps.title: List open breaches and approved exceptions in Microsoft Excel
sop: List every open zonal breach with its status and the amount over limit.
List approved exceptions with their expiry dates.
Flag exceptions expiring before the next committee.
Done when all open breaches and exceptions are listed with status.
verify: Compare the list to the breach register.
Pass when every open register item appears on the list.

steps.title: Assemble the committee paper
sop: Assemble the PML, appetite and breach sections into the committee paper.
Add the appendix citing the accumulation run identifier and model settings.
Circulate the paper ahead of the committee to the agreed timetable.
Done when the committee paper is assembled and circulated.
verify: Check the appendix cites the run identifier and model version.
Pass when both are present in the appendix.

steps.title: Table the report at the risk management committee
sop: Table the CAT report at the quarterly risk management committee.
Take the committee through appetite position, breaches and reinsurance cover.
Seek decisions on items requiring appetite or programme change.
Done when the report is tabled and decisions are taken.
verify: Check the committee minutes record the tabling.
Pass when the minutes show the report was tabled.

steps.title: Record decisions and actions in the minutes
sop: Record the committee decisions and actions with owners and due dates.
Update the CAT action log with the new items.
Confirm the minutes reflect the figures as presented.
Done when decisions and actions are recorded in the minutes.
verify: Read the minutes for owner and due date on each action.
Pass when every action carries an owner and due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The validated geocoded in-force exposure file run against the agreed peril and region scenario set.
generic.In-scope period: The current modelling quarter with the prior quarter run held for comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure records, model vendor, version, event set, demand surge and secondary uncertainty settings all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Record count and total TIV loaded into the model match the source exposure file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Run record holds model vendor, version, event set and settings alongside the OEP and AEP results.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records rejected at model load are logged with the rejection reason and their materiality assessed.
generic.Test population: All modelled perils and regions in the agreed scenario set for the quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Quarter-on-quarter movement beyond the agreed tolerance must be attributed to a stated cause.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained movements route to the Exposure Management Manager before results are released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: PML and TVaR at standard return periods gross, net of fac and net of treaty with settings recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Catastrophe model run output and the results dataset in the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Load the validated exposure file into the Catastrophe Data Provider platform
sop: Load the validated geocoded in-force exposure file into the catastrophe model.
Confirm the loaded record count matches the source file count.
Log any record rejected at load with the rejection reason.
Done when the exposure file is loaded and the count reconciles.
verify: Compare loaded record count and total TIV to the source file.
Pass when both reconcile or the difference is fully explained by logged rejections.

steps.title: Configure the model settings and event set
sop: Select the agreed event set for each peril and region in the scenario set.
Set demand surge and secondary uncertainty to the agreed configuration.
Record the model vendor and version with the settings.
Done when settings and event set are configured and recorded.
verify: Read back the recorded settings from the run record.
Pass when vendor, version, event set and settings are all recorded.

steps.title: Run the scenario set and produce OEP and AEP curves
sop: Run the agreed peril and region scenario set to completion.
Produce OEP and AEP curves with PML and TVaR at the standard return periods.
Confirm the run completed without truncation or error.
Done when OEP and AEP curves with PML and TVaR are produced.
verify: Check the run log for errors or truncation.
Pass when the run log shows a clean completion.

steps.title: Apply the reinsurance structure for net results
sop: Apply the current facultative and treaty structure to produce net results.
Produce gross, net of fac and net of treaty results from the same run.
Confirm the structure version used is the placed programme.
Done when results exist on all three bases from one run.
verify: Check the structure version cited against the placed programme.
Pass when the cited version is the current placed structure.

steps.title: Compare to the prior quarter in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Compare the current run to the prior quarter at each return period.
Identify movements above the agreed tolerance.
Attribute each movement to exposure change, model change or structure change.
Done when every material movement carries an attribution.
verify: Check each material movement has a stated attribution.
Pass when no material movement is left unattributed.

steps.title: Release the results with the Exposure Management Manager
sop: Review the results, settings record and movement attributions.
Challenge attributions not supported by known exposure or structure changes.
Release the results for accumulation reporting and committee use.
Done when the run results are released for downstream use.
verify: Check the release record cites the run identifier.
Pass when the release names the run identifier and its settings record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Per-risk limits, per-occurrence limits and zonal sublimits across every CAT-exposed line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year of the placed reinsurance programme, effective from the schedule effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Limit type, value, zone or line, effective date, treaty reference and approver populated on the schedule.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aggregate of zonal sublimits reconciles to the horizontal cover available for a multi-event year.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Limit schedule carries a version number, effective date and the placed programme reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Limits set outside treaty capacity because of unplaced shortfall are logged with the accepted retained position.
generic.Test population: All limits on the schedule and their configuration in the underwriting workstation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No bind may be permitted above a loaded CAT limit without referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Risks above limit route to referral at the authority level the matrix requires.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved limit schedule with per-risk, per-occurrence and zonal sublimits and an effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Published limit schedule and the limit configuration in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Confirm the placed programme structure in the Reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract the placed reinsurance programme structure including retention and layer limits.
Identify any unplaced or co-reinsurance shortfall in each layer.
Record the signed shares supporting each layer.
Done when the placed structure and any shortfall are confirmed.
verify: Compare extracted shares to the signed slip.
Pass when the extracted structure matches the signed slip.

steps.title: Set per-risk and per-occurrence limits
sop: Set per-risk and per-occurrence CAT limits so the retained position sits within treaty retention and appetite.
Account for the unplaced shortfall when setting the retained position.
State the rationale for each limit level.
Done when per-risk and per-occurrence limits are set with rationale.
verify: Test the retained position implied by the limits against appetite.
Pass when the retained position sits within the approved appetite.

steps.title: Set zonal sublimits against horizontal cover
sop: Set zonal sublimits for each peril zone in the programme scope.
Check the aggregate of zonal sublimits against the horizontal cover for a multi-event year.
Reduce sublimits where the aggregate exceeds available horizontal cover.
Done when zonal sublimits are set within available horizontal cover.
verify: Sum the zonal sublimits and compare to horizontal cover.
Pass when the aggregate does not exceed the horizontal cover available.

steps.title: Load the approved limits into the underwriting workstation
sop: Load each approved limit into the underwriting workstation against its zone or line.
Set the rule so binding above limit is blocked or forced to referral.
Set the activation to the schedule effective date.
Done when all approved limits are loaded and active on the effective date.
verify: Attempt a test bind above a loaded limit in the workstation.
Pass when the test bind is blocked or routed to referral.

steps.title: Publish the limit schedule and supersede the prior version
sop: Publish the limit schedule with its version number and effective date.
Mark the prior schedule as superseded at the same effective date.
Distribute the schedule to underwriting and exposure management.
Done when the schedule is published and the prior version superseded.
verify: Search for live schedules for the same scope.
Pass when only one schedule is live for each zone and line.

steps.title: Confirm alignment with the reinsurance programme
sop: Compare the published limits against the treaty terms line by line.
Confirm no limit exposes a retained position beyond the treaty retention.
Record the confirmation against the limit schedule.
Done when reinsurance alignment is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Check the recorded confirmation covers every limit on the schedule.
Pass when no limit is left unconfirmed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every in-force location record submitted to the location data-quality rule set for the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The in-force position as at the accumulation cycle date, validated before geocoding and modelling.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Address, postcode, occupancy code, construction code, year built, storeys and TIV components populated and in range.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Building, contents and BI values sum to the policy TIV for every validated location.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Data-quality score published with the rule set version and the file as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every failed record is logged to the data-quality issue tracker with a rule code and an owning underwriter.
generic.Test population: All in-force location records in the validation run for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The file must meet the minimum data-quality score before release to modelling.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed records route to the owning underwriter for correction and are re-validated before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Published data-quality score with pass or fail against the minimum and no unlogged failed records.
generic.Evidence location: Data-quality issue tracker and the validation output in the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Extract the in-force location file from the policy administration system
sop: Extract all in-force locations with address, coding and value fields for the cycle.
Include the owning underwriter and policy reference on each row.
Record the input row count for reconciliation.
Done when the location file is extracted with its row count.
verify: Compare the extract count to the in-force location count.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Run the completeness and code validity rules
sop: Run rules for address completeness and valid postcode across the file.
Test occupancy and construction codes against the approved code lists.
Test year built and number of storeys for plausible ranges.
Done when the completeness and validity rules have run over the full file.
verify: Check the rule run covered every input row.
Pass when rule coverage equals the input row count.

steps.title: Test TIV component consistency in Microsoft Excel
sop: Flag missing or default TIV values on any location.
Test that building, contents and BI values sum to the policy TIV.
Flag locations where the components do not reconcile.
Done when TIV consistency is tested across the file.
verify: Recompute the component sum for a sample of ten locations.
Pass when all ten reconcile or are already flagged.

steps.title: Detect duplicate locations across policies
sop: Detect duplicate locations by address match and coordinate proximity.
Group suspected duplicates for review rather than deleting them automatically.
Confirm genuine shared locations are recorded once for aggregation.
Done when suspected duplicates are grouped for review.
verify: Review a sample of duplicate groups.
Pass when each sampled group is a genuine duplicate or has been dismissed with a reason.

steps.title: Log failures to the data-quality issue tracker
sop: Log every failed record with its rule code to the data-quality issue tracker.
Route each issue to the owning underwriter for correction.
Set a correction due date on each logged issue.
Done when every failure is logged and routed.
verify: Compare failed record count to tracker entry count.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Publish the data-quality score and release the file
sop: Publish the data-quality score for the file against the minimum threshold.
Hold the file where the score falls below the minimum.
Release the file to modelling once the threshold is met.
Done when the score is published and the release decision is made.
verify: Read the published score against the minimum threshold.
Pass when the released file meets or exceeds the minimum score.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every segment exceeding its concentration limit and requiring a binding block or referral rule.
generic.In-scope period: From the restriction effective date until the recorded review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Segment, restriction scope, class, geography, limit band, effective date, review date and referral path populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Restricted segment list matches the over-limit segment list from concentration monitoring.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Restriction configuration record holds the approver, effective date and the rule test evidence.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approved referrals in restricted segments are logged with the approver and the reason for acceptance.
generic.Test population: All configured restrictions and a scripted sample submission for each restricted segment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No new bind may complete in a restricted segment without an approved referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Restricted risks route to the Portfolio UW Manager rather than being auto-declined.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Restriction configured with scope, effective date, review date and referral path recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation rule configuration and the restriction register.

steps.title: Confirm the over-limit segment list
sop: Take the list of segments exceeding concentration limits from the monitoring output.
Confirm each is genuinely over limit rather than a data or mapping artefact.
Record the exposure over limit for each segment.
Done when the restricted segment list is confirmed.
verify: Compare the restriction list to the concentration monitoring output.
Pass when every listed segment appears as over limit in monitoring.

steps.title: Define the restriction scope per segment
sop: Define whether the restriction covers new business only or new business and renewals.
State the class, geography and limit band the restriction applies to.
Set the effective date and the review date for each restriction.
Done when scope, dates and review date are defined for every restriction.
verify: Check each restriction record for scope, effective date and review date.
Pass when all three are present on every restriction.

steps.title: Configure the block or referral rule in the underwriting workstation
sop: Configure the binding block or referral rule for each restricted segment.
Set the referral path so restricted risks route to the Portfolio UW Manager.
Avoid configuring an automatic decline where referral is required.
Done when the rule is configured for every restricted segment.
verify: Inspect the configured rule for each restricted segment.
Pass when every rule routes to referral rather than auto-decline.

steps.title: Test the rule on a sample submission
sop: Enter a scripted sample submission in each restricted segment.
Confirm the submission is stopped or referred as intended.
Record the test result against the restriction record.
Done when every restriction is tested with a recorded result.
verify: Read the test result for each restriction.
Pass when every tested submission was stopped or referred.

steps.title: Confirm policy system alignment
sop: Confirm the policy administration system will not accept a bind that bypasses the workstation rule.
Test one bind path directly in the policy system for a restricted segment.
Close any bypass route found.
Done when no bypass route remains for restricted segments.
verify: Attempt a bypass bind in the policy administration system.
Pass when the bypass attempt is blocked or referred.

steps.title: Notify underwriters and distribution of the restriction
sop: Notify affected underwriters and distribution of the restriction and effective date.
State the exception route and who can approve an exception.
Confirm the notification reached every affected underwriter.
Done when the restriction is notified before the effective date.
verify: Compare the notification date to the effective date.
Pass when the notification precedes the effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound and quoted new-business pipeline added to the in-force exposure base across all zones and segments.
generic.In-scope period: The current pipeline period, assessed at the plan hit ratio for conversion.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Account, zone, segment, TIV, limit, expected conversion and marginal contribution populated per pipeline item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pipeline premium and TIV reconcile to the workstation pipeline report for the same date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment records the pipeline extract date, the in-force as-at date and the hit ratio applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Pipeline accounts consuming more than the agreed share of headroom are individually flagged with the amount.
generic.Test population: All bound and quoted pipeline items for the period plus the in-force exposure base.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Any zone or segment moving into the warning band on plan conversion must be flagged.
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged accounts route to the Exposure Management Manager for a pre-bind exposure view.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Marginal new-business impact shown alongside the in-force base at plan hit ratio.
generic.Evidence location: New-business impact dataset in the enterprise data warehouse and its Power BI page.

steps.title: Extract the bound and quoted pipeline from the underwriting workstation
sop: Extract bound and quoted new business with zone, segment, TIV and limit.
Record the pipeline extract date.
Reconcile the extract to the workstation pipeline report.
Done when the pipeline extract is produced and reconciled.
verify: Compare extract premium to the workstation pipeline report.
Pass when the two agree within tolerance.

steps.title: Add the pipeline to the in-force base in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Add the pipeline to the in-force exposure base on consistent zone and segment coding.
Re-run the zonal and segment aggregation on the combined base.
Keep the in-force-only aggregation for comparison.
Done when the combined aggregation is produced alongside the in-force base.
verify: Check both aggregations use the same zone scheme version.
Pass when the scheme version matches across both runs.

steps.title: Show marginal contribution by zone and segment in Power BI
sop: Show the marginal contribution of new business to each zone and segment.
Present the marginal figure separately from the post-bind total.
Rank zones and segments by marginal contribution.
Done when marginal contribution is published for every zone and segment.
verify: Check marginal plus in-force equals the combined total per zone.
Pass when the identity holds for every zone.

steps.title: Apply the plan hit ratio and test against limits
sop: Apply the plan hit ratio to the quoted pipeline to model expected conversion.
Identify zones and segments moving into the warning band or over limit on conversion.
Flag those zones and segments for pre-emptive action.
Done when warning-band and over-limit outcomes are identified.
verify: Check the hit ratio applied against the plan of record.
Pass when the applied hit ratio matches the plan.

steps.title: Report the diversification effect
sop: Identify which pipeline business reduces concentration and which compounds it.
Report the diversification effect by zone and segment.
Highlight business that improves the portfolio balance.
Done when the diversification effect is reported.
verify: Check every reported zone carries a diversification direction.
Pass when no zone is left without a stated direction.

steps.title: Flag headroom-consuming accounts with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Flag pipeline accounts consuming more than the agreed share of remaining headroom.
State the headroom consumed and the zone affected for each flagged account.
Route flagged accounts for a pre-bind exposure view.
Done when every headroom-consuming account is individually flagged.
verify: Recompute headroom consumption for the top three accounts.
Pass when all three exceed the threshold and appear as flagged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Industry class, geography, limit band and single-insured aggregation dimensions against appetite parameters.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring period compared against the prior period position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Dimension, current share, appetite parameter, drift since prior period, driving accounts and owner populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Shares across each dimension sum to the total portfolio for that dimension.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Watchlist entries record the data-as-at date and the appetite statement version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every dimension beyond the drift tolerance is added to the watchlist with an owner and review date.
generic.Test population: All monitored dimensions with an appetite parameter for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Movement beyond the agreed drift tolerance requires a watchlist entry even where within limit.
generic.Exception handling path: Drift caused by data or mapping change routes to the Portfolio Analyst for correction rather than the watchlist.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Watchlist entries for every dimension breaching drift tolerance with driving accounts, owner and review date.
generic.Evidence location: Portfolio watchlist and the Power BI concentration drift page for the period.

steps.title: Compute current shares by dimension in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Compute current share by industry class, geography, limit band and single-insured aggregation.
Use consistent premium or TIV bases across all dimensions.
Record the data-as-at date on the computation.
Done when current shares are computed for every dimension.
verify: Sum shares within each dimension.
Pass when each dimension sums to the portfolio total.

steps.title: Compare shares to appetite parameters in Power BI
sop: Compare each share against the appetite parameter for that dimension.
Mark each as within, warning or outside the appetite range.
Cite the appetite statement version used.
Done when every dimension carries a comparison result.
verify: Check the appetite statement version cited.
Pass when the version is the current approved statement.

steps.title: Measure drift against the prior period
sop: Measure movement in each share since the prior period.
Flag dimensions moving more than the agreed drift tolerance even where still within limit.
Show the direction and size of movement for each flag.
Done when drift is measured and flagged across all dimensions.
verify: Recompute drift for three flagged dimensions.
Pass when the recomputed drift matches the published figure.

steps.title: Distinguish growth-driven from shrinkage-driven drift
sop: Test whether each flagged drift results from growth in that dimension or shrinkage elsewhere.
State the cause on each flag rather than reporting the movement alone.
Use absolute premium movement to support the classification.
Done when every flag states whether drift is growth or shrinkage driven.
verify: Check each flag carries a growth or shrinkage classification.
Pass when no flag is left unclassified.

steps.title: Attach driving accounts to each flag
sop: Attach the policies or accounts driving each flagged dimension.
Rank them by contribution so action can be targeted.
Include enough detail for the recipient to act without re-running the analysis.
Done when every flag carries its driving accounts.
verify: Check each flag lists at least the top contributing accounts.
Pass when no flag is issued without driving accounts.

steps.title: Add flags to the watchlist with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Add each flag to the portfolio watchlist with an owner and review date.
Confirm the owner has the authority to act on that dimension.
Close prior watchlist items that have returned within tolerance.
Done when the watchlist reflects all current flags with owners and dates.
verify: Filter watchlist entries for missing owner or review date.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: Emerging trends material enough to justify an appetite or guideline change rather than routine monitoring.
generic.In-scope period: The current review period, put to the CUO ahead of the quarterly appetite review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trend, observed movement, persistence, premium and exposure affected and proposed parameter change populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium and exposure quoted per trend reconcile to the portfolio monitoring views for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Shortlist records the data-as-at date and the monitoring views the movements were drawn from.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferred items are recorded with the reason and carried to the next quarterly appetite review agenda.
generic.Test population: All shortlisted emerging trends put to the CUO in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each shortlisted trend must carry a recorded accept, defer or reject response.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected trends return to routine monitoring with the rejection reason recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Shortlist with proposed appetite change and a recorded CUO response per item.
generic.Evidence location: Emerging trend shortlist file and the appetite review agenda for the next quarter.

steps.title: Draw candidate trends from the Power BI monitoring views
sop: Review the trend, composition and utilisation pages for persistent movements.
Draw candidates that have persisted across more than one period.
Record the movement and the periods it spans for each candidate.
Done when the candidate trend list is drawn.
verify: Trace each candidate back to its monitoring view.
Pass when every candidate traces to a published view.

steps.title: Shortlist trends justifying an appetite change
sop: Filter candidates to those justifying an appetite or guideline change.
Exclude movements adequately handled by routine monitoring.
State why each shortlisted trend needs a parameter change.
Done when the shortlist is filtered with reasoning per item.
verify: Check each shortlisted item states why monitoring is insufficient.
Pass when no shortlisted item lacks that reasoning.

steps.title: Quantify premium and exposure affected in Microsoft Excel
sop: Quantify the premium and exposure affected by each shortlisted trend.
Reconcile the figures to the portfolio monitoring views.
Show the figures alongside the observed movement.
Done when premium and exposure are quantified for every item.
verify: Reconcile two quantified items to the monitoring views.
Pass when both reconcile.

steps.title: Propose the specific parameter change per item
sop: Name the specific guideline or appetite parameter that would change.
State the expected portfolio effect of the change.
Avoid general recommendations that do not name a parameter.
Done when every item names a parameter and an expected effect.
verify: Check each item names a specific parameter.
Pass when no item proposes a change without naming the parameter.

steps.title: Present the shortlist to the CUO
sop: Review the shortlist with the movement, quantification and proposed change.
Record accept, defer or reject against each item.
State the reason where an item is deferred or rejected.
Done when a response is recorded against every item.
verify: Filter the shortlist for items without a recorded response.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Carry deferred items into the next appetite review
sop: Add deferred items to the next quarterly appetite review agenda.
Record the deferral reason and the date for reconsideration.
Route accepted items into the guideline revision process.
Done when deferred and accepted items are routed onwards.
verify: Check the next appetite review agenda for the deferred items.
Pass when every deferred item appears on the agenda.

generic.Defined scope/population: Written premium and in-force TIV share by industry class, geography, limit band and distribution channel.
generic.In-scope period: The monthly monitoring cycle with the last four periods shown as trend.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class, geography, limit band, channel, share, appetite target range and status marker populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Shares within each dimension sum to total written premium and total in-force TIV.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Composition view cites the appetite statement version and the data-as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any policy found in a prohibited class or on the no-write list is logged and escalated immediately.
generic.Test population: All in-force and written business in the monthly monitoring cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No in-force policy may sit in a prohibited class or on the no-write list.
generic.Exception handling path: Prohibited-class findings route to the Portfolio UW Manager for cancellation or ratification decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Composition view against appetite target ranges with a four-period trend per dimension.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI composition page and its dataset in the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Measure share by class and geography in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Measure written premium and in-force TIV share by industry class and geography.
Use consistent class and geography coding across both measures.
Record the data-as-at date on the measurement.
Done when class and geography shares are measured.
verify: Sum shares within class and within geography.
Pass when each sums to the portfolio total.

steps.title: Measure share by limit band and distribution channel
sop: Measure share by limit band and by distribution channel on the same bases.
Confirm every policy maps to exactly one limit band and channel.
List policies with no band or channel for correction.
Done when limit band and channel shares are measured.
verify: Count policies without a band or channel mapping.
Pass when unmapped policies appear only on the correction list.

steps.title: Compare each share to the appetite target range in Power BI
sop: Compare each share to the target range in the current appetite statement.
Mark each as within, warning or outside the range.
Cite the appetite statement version on the view.
Done when every share carries a status marker.
verify: Check the cited appetite statement version.
Pass when the version is the current approved statement.

steps.title: Add the four-period trend per dimension
sop: Add the last four periods for each share so direction of travel is visible.
Show the trend alongside the point value rather than instead of it.
Highlight dimensions trending toward the range boundary.
Done when a four-period trend accompanies every share.
verify: Check the trend series length for a sample of dimensions.
Pass when each sampled dimension shows four periods.

steps.title: Test for prohibited class and no-write list policies
sop: Test the in-force book against the prohibited class list and the no-write list.
Log any hit with the policy reference and the underwriter.
Escalate hits to the Portfolio UW Manager immediately.
Done when the prohibited-class test has run and hits are escalated.
verify: Run the prohibited class query over the in-force book.
Pass when the query returns no unescalated rows.

steps.title: Publish the composition view on the monthly cycle
sop: Review the composition view and the status markers before publication.
Confirm the monthly publication cycle date is met.
Publish the view to underwriting management.
Done when the composition view is published on the agreed cycle.
verify: Compare the publication date to the agreed monthly cycle date.
Pass when publication falls within the agreed cycle.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every risk category, peril zone and limit band with an approved capacity limit.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period to date with a projection to year end at the current run rate.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Category, approved limit, consumed capacity, remaining headroom, utilisation percentage and projection populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consumed capacity plus remaining headroom equals the approved limit for every category.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report carries the data-as-at date and the version of the appetite limits used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Categories with negative headroom are listed separately with the amount over and any exception reference.
generic.Test population: All risk categories, peril zones and limit bands with an approved limit for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A category with negative headroom fails unless it carries an approved exception reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Negative headroom categories escalate to the Exposure Management Manager and Portfolio UW Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Utilisation report with consumed capacity, headroom and year-end projection by category.
generic.Evidence location: Appetite utilisation report file and the Power BI utilisation page for the period.

steps.title: Load approved limits by category from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Load the approved limit for each risk category, peril zone and limit band.
Record the version of the appetite limits used.
Flag categories with no approved limit for resolution.
Done when approved limits are loaded for every category.
verify: Check the limit version recorded on the dataset.
Pass when the version is the current approved set.

steps.title: Calculate consumed capacity and remaining headroom
sop: Calculate consumed capacity against each approved limit.
Derive remaining headroom as limit less consumed capacity.
Confirm consumed plus headroom equals the limit for every category.
Done when consumed capacity and headroom are calculated for every category.
verify: Test the consumed plus headroom identity across all categories.
Pass when the identity holds for every category.

steps.title: Express utilisation with the warning band in Power BI
sop: Express utilisation as both an absolute amount and a percentage of limit.
Shade the warning band on the utilisation view.
Sort categories by utilisation so the tightest surface first.
Done when utilisation is published with the warning band shaded.
verify: Recompute utilisation percentage for three categories.
Pass when the recomputed values match the published view.

steps.title: Project utilisation to year end at the current run rate
sop: Project each category to year end using the current run rate.
Flag categories on course to breach before year end.
State the run-rate assumption behind each projection.
Done when a year-end projection exists for every category.
verify: Check each projection states its run-rate assumption.
Pass when no projection is published without its assumption.

steps.title: List negative-headroom categories separately in Microsoft Excel
sop: List categories with negative headroom in a separate section.
State the amount over limit and the approved exception reference where one exists.
Escalate categories over limit with no exception.
Done when all negative-headroom categories are listed and escalated.
verify: Check each negative-headroom category shows the amount over and any exception.
Pass when no negative-headroom category is missing either field.

steps.title: Publish the report and review with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the utilisation report, projections and negative-headroom list.
Challenge projections that conflict with known pipeline activity.
Publish the report with the data-as-at date and limit version.
Done when the report is reviewed and published.
verify: Read the data-as-at date and limit version on the published report.
Pass when both are present on the published report.

generic.Defined scope/population: Portfolio composition, appetite utilisation and open breaches reported to the underwriting governance committee.
generic.In-scope period: The closed quarter, tabled at the scheduled quarterly governance committee.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Composition, utilisation, open breach status and prior-action RAG rating populated in the committee paper.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Headline figures in the committee paper match the quarterly portfolio review pack for the same quarter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Committee paper cites the quarter, the data-as-at date and the appetite statement version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items needing an appetite change or exception extension are recorded with the committee decision.
generic.Test population: All composition dimensions, utilisation categories and open breaches for the quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every item requiring committee action must carry a minuted decision, owner and due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Items deferred by the committee carry a reason and a retabling date in the action log.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quarterly committee paper covering composition, utilisation, open breaches and prior-action status.
generic.Evidence location: Governance committee pack and minutes plus the portfolio action log.

steps.title: Assemble the composition and utilisation sections in Power BI
sop: Assemble portfolio composition and appetite utilisation for the quarter.
Use the same figures as the quarterly portfolio review pack.
Cite the appetite statement version on each section.
Done when the composition and utilisation sections are assembled.
verify: Compare headline figures to the quarterly review pack.
Pass when the figures match the pack for the same quarter.

steps.title: List open breaches with current status
sop: List every open appetite or concentration breach with its current status.
Show the amount over limit and any approved exception with its expiry.
Flag exceptions expiring before the next committee.
Done when all open breaches are listed with status.
verify: Compare the list to the breach register.
Pass when every open register item appears.

steps.title: Rate prior committee actions in Microsoft Excel
sop: Take every action raised at the previous committee and record its current status.
Apply a red, amber or green rating to each action.
State the reason for any red rating.
Done when every prior action carries a status and RAG rating.
verify: Filter prior actions for missing status or rating.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Identify items needing a committee decision
sop: Identify items requiring an appetite change or an exception extension.
State the decision sought explicitly for each item.
Provide the supporting evidence with each decision request.
Done when every decision item states the decision sought.
verify: Check each decision item names the decision sought.
Pass when no decision item is ambiguous.

steps.title: Table the paper at the governance committee
sop: Table the paper at the underwriting governance committee for the quarter.
Take the committee through composition, utilisation, breaches and prior actions.
Seek explicit decisions on the items raised.
Done when the paper is tabled and decisions are taken.
verify: Check the minutes record the tabling of the paper.
Pass when the minutes confirm the paper was tabled.

steps.title: Record decisions, owners and due dates in the minutes
sop: Record the decision, owner and due date for each item requiring action.
Update the portfolio action log with the new items.
Circulate the minutes to the committee members.
Done when decisions and actions are recorded and circulated.
verify: Check each actioned item in the minutes for owner and due date.
Pass when no actioned item is missing either.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every treaty layer in the current treaty year carrying ceded or retained exposure.
generic.In-scope period: The current treaty year to date, tracked against the signed slip terms.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Layer, occurrence limit, aggregate limit, reinstatements used, aggregate deductible erosion and remaining capacity populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded exposure tracked per layer reconciles to the ceded position in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker cites the signed slip version for the treaty year and the data-as-at date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers below the agreed remaining-capacity warning level are escalated with the escalation recorded.
generic.Test population: All treaty layers active in the current treaty year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Any layer below the agreed remaining-capacity warning level must carry an escalation.
generic.Exception handling path: Terms differing from the signed slip route to the Reinsurance Analyst for correction before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Treaty capacity tracker showing occurrence and aggregate usage, deductible erosion and remaining reinstatements.
generic.Evidence location: Treaty capacity tracker in Power BI and the reinsurance administration system records.

steps.title: Load treaty terms from the Reinsurance administration system
sop: Load occurrence limit, aggregate limit and reinstatement terms for each layer.
Confirm the terms match the signed slip for the current treaty year.
Record the slip version used.
Done when treaty terms are loaded and matched to the slip.
verify: Compare loaded terms to the signed slip for two layers.
Pass when both match the slip exactly.

steps.title: Track ceded and retained exposure per layer
sop: Track ceded and retained exposure against each layer for the treaty year to date.
Reconcile the ceded position to the reinsurance system.
Record the data-as-at date.
Done when ceded and retained exposure is tracked per layer.
verify: Reconcile ceded exposure to the reinsurance system position.
Pass when the two agree within tolerance.

steps.title: Show aggregate deductible erosion and reinstatements in Power BI
sop: Show aggregate deductible erosion for the treaty year to date.
Show reinstatements used and remaining for each layer.
Present remaining aggregate capacity per layer.
Done when erosion and reinstatement position are published.
verify: Recompute remaining aggregate capacity for two layers.
Pass when the recomputed figures match the tracker.

steps.title: Compare appetite utilisation to treaty capacity
sop: Compare appetite utilisation with the treaty capacity supporting it.
Identify where appetite is being consumed beyond available cover.
Quantify the gap where one exists.
Done when appetite utilisation is compared to treaty capacity.
verify: Check every appetite category maps to a supporting layer.
Pass when no category is left unmapped.

steps.title: Escalate layers below the warning level
sop: Identify layers whose remaining aggregate capacity is below the warning level.
Escalate each with the remaining capacity and the exposure still to come.
Record the escalation date and recipients.
Done when every low-capacity layer is escalated.
verify: Compare low-capacity layers to escalation records.
Pass when every low-capacity layer has an escalation record.

steps.title: Review the tracker with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the tracker, the erosion position and the escalations raised.
Confirm the slip version used is the current treaty year.
Approve the tracker for portfolio and committee use.
Done when the tracker is reviewed and approved.
verify: Check the approval record cites the slip version.
Pass when the approval names the current treaty-year slip.

generic.Defined scope/population: New-business submission, quote and bound activity in each segment carrying an active restriction.
generic.In-scope period: The measurement period spanning equal windows before and after the restriction effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission, quote and bound counts, aggregate exposure, exception count and approval reference populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bound volume in the restricted segment reconciles between the workstation and the data warehouse.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Measurement records the restriction effective date and the before and after window boundaries.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every exception granted against the restriction is logged with its approval reference.
generic.Test population: All new-business activity in restricted segments across the before and after windows.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No business may be bound in a restricted segment without a block override or approved exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Leakage found without an override or exception is investigated and raised as a control finding.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Before and after volume and exposure comparison with a maintain, ease or tighten recommendation.
generic.Evidence location: Restriction effectiveness workbook and the Power BI restricted segment page.

steps.title: Extract restricted segment activity from the underwriting workstation
sop: Extract submission, quote and bound volume for each restricted segment.
Split the extract into equal windows before and after the effective date.
Record the restriction effective date on the extract.
Done when before and after activity is extracted per restricted segment.
verify: Compare window lengths before and after the effective date.
Pass when the two windows are of equal length.

steps.title: Compare aggregate exposure movement in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Measure the restricted segment aggregate exposure at the start and end of the period.
Confirm the movement is in the intended direction and quantify it.
Separate movement caused by the restriction from natural run-off.
Done when the exposure movement is quantified and attributed.
verify: Recompute the exposure movement for one restricted segment.
Pass when the recomputed movement matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Count and check exceptions granted
sop: Count exceptions granted against each restriction in the period.
Check each carried the required approval before binding.
List exceptions lacking a valid approval.
Done when all exceptions are counted and approval-checked.
verify: Compare the exception count to approval records.
Pass when every exception has a matching approval record.

steps.title: Identify leakage bound without block or referral
sop: Identify business bound in the restricted segment that was neither blocked nor referred.
Investigate the cause of each leakage case.
Raise a control finding where the rule failed to fire.
Done when all leakage is identified and its cause established.
verify: Query bound business in restricted segments against override and exception records.
Pass when every bound risk maps to an override or approved exception.

steps.title: Publish the effectiveness comparison in Power BI
sop: Publish the before and after comparison of volume and exposure per restricted segment.
Show the exception count and leakage cases alongside.
Stamp the view with the measurement period boundaries.
Done when the effectiveness comparison is published.
verify: Check the published view shows both windows and the exception count.
Pass when all three elements are present.

steps.title: Recommend maintain, ease or tighten with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Review the comparison, exceptions and leakage findings.
Recommend maintain, ease or tighten with the supporting numbers stated.
Set the date for the next effectiveness review.
Done when a recommendation with supporting numbers is recorded.
verify: Check the recommendation cites the supporting figures.
Pass when the recommendation is evidenced by the published comparison.

generic.Defined scope/population: Pricing loss ratio, frequency and severity assumptions by segment tested against developed experience.
generic.In-scope period: The accident or underwriting years with credible developed experience for the current validation cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Segment, assumption value, actual developed value, variance, credibility view and agreed change populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actual experience used reconciles to the actuarial reserving dataset for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation record cites the actuarial run version, the LDF set and the effective pricing cycle.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments outside assumption tolerance are recorded as credible or noise with the reasoning stated.
generic.Test population: All segments with pricing assumptions and credible developed experience in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Segments outside the assumption tolerance require an agreed credible or noise determination.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved disagreements between underwriting and actuarial escalate to the Underwriting Director.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documented validation showing assumption versus actual by segment and the agreed changes with a pricing cycle.
generic.Evidence location: Validation record in the actuarial modelling platform outputs and the underwriting assumption log.

steps.title: Extract pricing assumptions by segment in Microsoft Excel
sop: Extract the loss ratio, frequency and severity assumptions used in pricing by segment.
Record the pricing cycle the assumptions belong to.
Confirm the assumption set is the one currently in use.
Done when the current assumption set is extracted by segment.
verify: Check the assumption set version against the pricing model in use.
Pass when the extracted set matches the live pricing set.

steps.title: Extract developed experience from the Actuarial modeling platform
sop: Extract developed loss ratio, frequency and severity by segment for the same years.
Record the actuarial run version and LDF set used.
Reconcile the extract to the reserving dataset.
Done when developed experience is extracted and reconciled.
verify: Reconcile extracted experience to the reserving dataset.
Pass when the two agree within tolerance.

steps.title: Compare assumption to actual by segment
sop: Compare each assumption to the developed actual by segment.
Calculate the variance and compare it to the assumption tolerance.
List segments outside tolerance for discussion.
Done when every segment carries a variance and tolerance test.
verify: Recompute variance for three segments.
Pass when the recomputed variances match the comparison.

steps.title: Review development factors and large-loss distortions
sop: Review the loss development factors and trend assumptions actuarial applied.
Confirm the underwriting view of any large-loss distortions in the experience.
State where a single event is driving an apparent trend.
Done when LDF and large-loss distortion review is complete.
verify: Check each distorted segment carries an underwriting comment.
Pass when no distorted segment is left uncommented.

steps.title: Agree credibility and assumption changes with actuarial
sop: Agree with actuarial whether each out-of-tolerance segment is credible or noise.
Agree the assumption changes to carry into the next pricing cycle.
Record any point of disagreement for escalation.
Done when a credibility view and change decision exist for every segment.
verify: Filter out-of-tolerance segments for missing credibility determination.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Document the agreed position with the Underwriting Director
sop: Review the agreed assumption changes and any escalated disagreements.
Document the agreed position, the segments changed and the effective pricing cycle.
Route the documented position into the pricing and planning cycle.
Done when the agreed position is documented and routed.
verify: Check the documented position states the effective pricing cycle.
Pass when the pricing cycle is named in the record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriting guideline retired in the period across all lines of business.
generic.In-scope period: The effective-from and effective-to dates of each retired guideline version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, effective-from, effective-to, approver, rationale and superseding version link populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived retired versions match the retirement log entries for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived version held read-only with its approval record and version history attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Retired guidelines with a missing approval record are logged and the gap reconstructed or noted.
generic.Test population: All retired guideline versions archived in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A point-in-time retrieval must return the guideline in force on a chosen historical date.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed retrieval tests route to the Portfolio Analyst for index correction and re-testing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Read-only archived guidelines with version dates, approval record and a link to the superseding version.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting guideline archive in the enterprise data warehouse with its retention class applied.

steps.title: Identify guidelines retired in the period
sop: List every guideline version retired in the period from the retirement log.
Confirm each has a superseding version or a stated reason for outright withdrawal.
Record the line of business for each retired version.
Done when the retired guideline list is compiled.
verify: Compare the list to the retirement log.
Pass when every log entry appears on the list.

steps.title: Attach version numbers and effective dates
sop: Attach the version number, effective-from and effective-to dates to each retired document.
Confirm the effective-to date matches the superseding version effective-from date.
Correct any gap or overlap between versions.
Done when every retired version carries complete date fields.
verify: Test for gaps or overlaps in the effective-date chain.
Pass when the chain is continuous with no overlap.

steps.title: Link each retired version to its successor
sop: Link every retired version to the version that superseded it.
Confirm the chain is traceable from the current version back through all predecessors.
Note versions withdrawn without replacement.
Done when the change chain is traceable end to end.
verify: Trace one guideline chain from current back to origin.
Pass when every link in the chain resolves.

steps.title: Preserve the approval record with the archived version
sop: Attach the approver, approval date and rationale to the archived version.
Do not rely on the live version alone to hold the approval history.
Log versions where the approval record cannot be located.
Done when every archived version carries its approval record.
verify: Check a sample of archived versions for approval records.
Pass when every sampled version holds approver, date and rationale.

steps.title: Set the archive read-only with the retention class
sop: Set the archived versions to read-only.
Apply the underwriting-records retention class and disposal date.
Confirm the archive cannot be edited after the retention class is applied.
Done when the archive is read-only with retention applied.
verify: Attempt an edit on an archived version.
Pass when the edit is rejected.

steps.title: Run a point-in-time retrieval test with the Portfolio UW Manager
sop: Choose a past date and retrieve the guideline in force on that date.
Confirm the retrieved version matches the effective-date chain.
Record the test result against the archive.
Done when the point-in-time retrieval test is recorded.
verify: Compare the retrieved version to the effective-date chain for that date.
Pass when the retrieved version is the one in force on the chosen date.

generic.Defined scope/population: New product launches, regulatory and filing changes, court decisions and market dislocations in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The assessment period feeding the next quarterly appetite review agenda.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: External change, affected appetite parameters, premium and exposure at stake and recommendation populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium and exposure at stake reconcile to the portfolio views for the affected parameters.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment cites the source of each external change and the data-as-at date of the quantification.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes with no measurable appetite impact are recorded as assessed with the reasoning stated.
generic.Test population: All external changes in scope for the assessment period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every external change must map to affected parameters or be recorded as having none.
generic.Exception handling path: Changes requiring legal or compliance interpretation route to the CUO before a recommendation is set.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment mapping each change to parameters with premium and exposure at stake and a recommendation.
generic.Evidence location: External impact assessment file and the quarterly appetite review agenda.

steps.title: List the external changes in scope in Microsoft Excel
sop: List new product launches, regulatory and filing changes and court decisions for the period.
Add market dislocations and capacity shifts affecting the lines written.
Cite the source for each listed change.
Done when the external change list is compiled with sources.
verify: Check every listed change carries a source reference.
Pass when no change is listed without a source.

steps.title: Map each change to affected appetite parameters
sop: Map each change to the specific appetite parameters it affects.
Cover class, geography, limit, attachment and deductible parameters.
Record changes with no parameter impact as assessed with the reasoning.
Done when every change maps to parameters or is recorded as having none.
verify: Filter changes without a parameter mapping or a nil assessment.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Quantify premium and exposure at stake in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Quantify the premium and exposure at stake for each affected parameter.
Reconcile the figures to the portfolio views for those parameters.
Record the data-as-at date of the quantification.
Done when premium and exposure are quantified for every affected parameter.
verify: Reconcile two quantifications to the portfolio views.
Pass when both reconcile within tolerance.

steps.title: Assess the direction of impact in Power BI
sop: Assess whether each change widens, narrows or leaves appetite unchanged.
Consider the interaction between changes rather than assessing each in isolation.
State the assessment reasoning for each parameter.
Done when the direction of impact is assessed for every parameter.
verify: Check each parameter carries a direction and reasoning.
Pass when no parameter is left without both.

steps.title: Recommend no change, monitor or amend
sop: Recommend no change, monitor or amend for each affected parameter.
State the reasoning behind each recommendation.
Set a review date for monitor recommendations.
Done when every affected parameter carries a recommendation.
verify: Filter parameters for missing recommendations.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Route amend recommendations to the CUO and the review agenda
sop: Review the amend recommendations and the supporting quantification.
Confirm which recommendations proceed to the quarterly appetite review agenda.
Record the CUO position against each amend recommendation.
Done when the CUO position is recorded and the agenda items are set.
verify: Check the appetite review agenda against the amend recommendations.
Pass when every approved amend recommendation appears on the agenda.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriter and manager in the lines affected by the configured appetite rule change.
generic.In-scope period: From issue of the change note through to the rule effective date and the transition window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Parameter, before value, after value, effective date, referral trigger and transition treatment populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parameters described in the note match the parameters configured in the underwriting workstation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated change note retained with the acknowledgement record and the intranet page version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Underwriters who do not acknowledge within the window are chased and the outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: All changed parameters and all underwriters and managers in the affected lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The change note must be issued before the effective date and acknowledged by affected underwriters.
generic.Exception handling path: Queries on the change route to the Portfolio UW Manager and are answered before the effective date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated change note showing before and after values, referral triggers and transition treatment.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting intranet appetite page and the acknowledgement record for the change.

steps.title: Extract the configured parameters from the underwriting workstation
sop: Extract the configured appetite parameters and their before and after values.
Confirm the extract matches the approved change record.
List the referral triggers created or changed.
Done when the configured parameter set is extracted.
verify: Compare the extract to the approved change record.
Pass when every configured parameter matches the approved change.

steps.title: Draft the appetite change note
sop: Draft the note stating what changed, the effective date and the transition treatment.
Show before and after values for each parameter rather than the new value alone.
State how in-flight submissions are handled.
Done when the change note is drafted with all required elements.
verify: Check the note shows before and after values for every changed parameter.
Pass when no parameter shows only its new value.

steps.title: Explain the new referral triggers and routing
sop: Explain each new or changed referral trigger and who the referral goes to.
Confirm the routing described matches the workstation configuration.
Give an example of a submission that would now refer.
Done when referral triggers and routing are explained in the note.
verify: Compare the described routing to the workstation configuration.
Pass when the note routing matches the configured routing.

steps.title: Distribute the note to affected underwriters
sop: Send the note to every underwriter and manager in the affected lines.
Confirm the distribution list matches the current org structure.
Issue the note before the effective date.
Done when the note reaches all affected underwriters before the effective date.
verify: Compare the send date to the effective date.
Pass when the note was sent before the effective date.

steps.title: Capture acknowledgement from affected underwriters
sop: Acknowledge receipt and understanding of the change note.
Raise any question on the change before the effective date.
Record the acknowledgement against the change record.
Done when acknowledgement is captured from affected underwriters.
verify: Filter the affected underwriter list for missing acknowledgements.
Pass when the filter returns no rows or all remaining are chased.

steps.title: Publish the current rules and retire the superseded page
sop: Publish the current appetite rules to the underwriting intranet page.
Retire the superseded page so only the current rules are discoverable.
Link the Power BI appetite view to the published page.
Done when the current rules are published and the old page retired.
verify: Search the intranet for superseded appetite pages.
Pass when only the current page is discoverable.

generic.Defined scope/population: All proposed appetite changes for the quarter reviewed with product management, actuarial and reinsurance.
generic.In-scope period: The quarterly review cycle, with the pre-read circulated five working days ahead.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Proposed change, supporting evidence, decision, reason, action owner and due date populated per item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items on the agenda match the proposed changes carried into the minutes and the change list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Minutes record attendance, the pre-read version circulated and the decision per change.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes deferred for more evidence are recorded with the evidence required and the retabling date.
generic.Test population: Every proposed appetite change tabled at the quarterly review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The review fails if product management, actuarial or reinsurance is unrepresented.
generic.Exception handling path: Items lacking a required function's input are deferred rather than decided.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Minutes recording required attendance and a decision per proposed change with the pre-read lead time met.
generic.Evidence location: Quarterly appetite review pre-read, minutes and the agreed change list.

steps.title: Assemble the pre-read in Power BI and Microsoft Excel
sop: Assemble portfolio performance, appetite utilisation and concentration position for the pre-read.
Add the proposed appetite changes with their supporting evidence.
Version the pre-read so the circulated copy is identifiable.
Done when the pre-read is assembled and versioned.
verify: Check the pre-read covers performance, utilisation, concentration and proposals.
Pass when all four sections are present.

steps.title: Circulate the pre-read five working days ahead
sop: Circulate the pre-read at least five working days before the meeting.
Send to underwriting, product management, actuarial and reinsurance representatives.
